_README: Edit these answers anytime — they power the 'Have a question?' popup. Review the payment, occupancy, and approval answers to match your exact policy.

faqs.q: How fast can I move in?
faqs.a: Most rooms are next-day move-in once you're approved. Approval is usually quick.

faqs.q: How does payment work / when is rent due?
faqs.a: Rent is paid weekly, in advance. Your first payment is due when you book, and after that you're billed automatically on the same weekday each week.

faqs.q: Can I tour a home before booking?
faqs.a: You can explore every room and common area through the photos and 3D tour on each listing. If you'd like more detail on a specific home, just text us.

faqs.q: Can two people share a room, or can I bring a child?
faqs.a: Most rooms are single-occupancy. Some homes allow double occupancy or children for an added fee — text us about a specific home and we'll confirm.

faqs.q: What do I need to get approved?
faqs.a: A quick background screening and proof you can cover rent (generally income around 3x the rent), with no recent evictions. PadSplit runs the screening during your application.
No long lease. You pay weekly and can stay as long as you like — most residents stay 6–12 months.
Your furnished room, all utilities, WiFi, and shared common areas — one weekly payment, no separate bills.
Every resident is background-checked, and each room has its own electronic door lock for privacy and security.
